What is your return policy?

Rugs USA Bot · AI says:

Our standard return policy (for most products shipped within the contiguous US, Alaska, and Hawaii) allows returns within 30 days of delivery as long as items are in the same condition as delivered. Returns must use our Rugs USA-provided label, and return shipping fees are deducted from your refund. You can choose store credit or refund to original payment.

We cannot accept returns for:

Items marked final sale
Used or laundered bedding, or bedding not in original packaging
Orders delivered to Canada or Puerto Rico
Items from the Custom by Rugs USA Collection
Orders shipped more than 30 days ago

Custom by Rugs USA items are final sale and cannot be returned or canceled once placed, due to their made-to-order nature. If there’s an issue with a custom product you received, you should email Customer Service with your name, order number (starting with WS), images of the product, and a summary of the issue.

For Canadian orders, we currently do not accept returns.

To start a return that qualifies under our policy, you can submit it online, where you’ll see the return shipping cost before confirming, and we’ll email you a return label. Each item you return needs its own label and must be securely wrapped, with any old labels removed or covered, then dropped off with FedEx. We can also help arrange a FedEx pickup in the US for an extra $10 added to the return label cost.

We do not offer direct exchanges, but you can opt for store credit, which never expires and can be used on our US and Canada sites.
